subject: Quote request: refrigerated transport Milan to Lyon
body:
Hello, we are looking for a carrier for cold chain transport from Milan to Lyon. We ship around 40 pallets per week of fresh produce and our budget is about €18,000 per month. We would like to start by next month, so a quote this week would be great.

Best regards,
Sofia Marchetti
Logistics Manager, Verde Foods

subject: Pricing?
body:
Hi, what's your pricing for sending a few boxes to Spain? Just curious for now.

Thanks
